caption: The drawing depicts a battle scene set amidst a decorative border of large tropical plants and flowers. In the center, there is a figure on horseback dressed in a blue military uniform with gold accents, pointing a sword forward. To the left, a soldier operates a cannon with blue wheels, and another figure lies on the ground nearby. To the right of the central horseman, more soldiers in blue uniforms are depicted, some on horseback and others appearing to be running or engaged in combat. The background features mountains and blue sky with stylized clouds, while on both the left and right sides, lines of soldiers can be seen, some carrying American flags. The whole composition is framed by leafy branches and clusters of round, brown fruit or flowers along the vertical edges and clusters of large, soft-colored flowers at the bottom. The color palette is dominated by browns, blues, greens, and muted reds, with outlines and shading done in dark brown or black. There is a signature on the bottom right corner.
title: Historical Printed Cotton
